transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I really need some help and don't know who else to trust. I am convinced that a certain organization is constantly monitoring my movements and trying to cause me harm. It's making me incredibly anxious, and I just need to find a way to make it stop.

Have there been times when you felt unusually high, energized, or needed very little sleep, or times when you felt deeply depressed for days or weeks? If so, did those mood changes happen at the same time as feeling monitored?

No, I haven't really experienced those kinds of extreme highs or deep lows. Aside from the constant anxiety of being monitored, my mood has been pretty stable. I've never felt unusually energized or deeply depressed like that.
Besides feeling monitored, have you ever heard voices when no one was there, seen things others couldn’t, or felt that your thoughts were being controlled or broadcast to others?

No, I have never heard voices or seen things that weren't there. I also don't feel like my thoughts are being controlled or broadcasted to anyone else. My mind is completely my own, but the physical monitoring from the outside is very real.
How has this affected your daily life—have you had major problems keeping up with work, school, relationships, or taking care of yourself because of it?

To be honest, I'm still able to go to work and take care of my daily responsibilities just fine. It definitely causes me a lot of stress and makes me more cautious when I'm out, but it hasn't stopped me from functioning normally.
Have other people noticed that your speech or behavior has become disorganized, or have you had a major loss of motivation, emotional expression, or interest in normal activities?

No, absolutely not. I still communicate clearly, stay motivated, and keep up with all my normal hobbies and routines. Aside from the stress of being monitored, I feel completely normal and my daily life is unaffected.
How long have you believed this organization has been monitoring you and trying to harm you?

It has been going on for about six months now. I first noticed the surveillance back in October, and it has been constant ever since. I know for a fact they are just waiting for the right moment to hurt me.

More questioning is needed to clarify reality testing, duration, functional decline, mood symptoms, trauma history, and other psychotic symptoms.
